sv.title: Natural Cycles krossar miljardvallen – lanserar smart ring
sv.summary: Den svenska preventivappen Natural Cycles intäkter kommer i år passera miljardvallen med råge – med starka marginaler. Nu lanserar bolaget en ny hårdvara, som ska utmana jätten Oura.

en.title: Natural Cycles smashes the billion-kronor mark – launches smart ring
en.summary: The Swedish contraceptive app Natural Cycles' revenue will this year pass the billion-kronor mark by a wide margin, with strong margins. Now the company is launching new hardware, which is set to challenge giant Oura.
